svg.title: Solder-side bench board: Ground and power
svg.desc: Proposed wire routing on a 27-column by 22-row isolated-pad carrier. Coordinates follow supplied solder-side labels. Physical footprints are schematic projections. Contact check required for button.
svg.text: SOLDER SIDE • Rows 01–22 • Columns A → Z → A2 run RIGHT TO LEFT
Proposed routing • exact solder-pad coordinates • component bodies shown only as location guides
component is on the far side
Pigtail cavity IDs; not wire colors

g.title: G01: ESP32 GND (J1.L22) (22 / Q) → Ground bus tap (04 / H); Black. Main carrier return to controller/USB ground
G02: Ground bus tap (04 / M) → Display GND (01 / N); Black. Display power return from the nearest available main-ground tap
G03: Ground bus tap (04 / J) → Translator GND_HV (09 / I); Black. Translator high-side ground pad
G04: Ground bus tap (04 / K) → Translator GND_LV (09 / M); Black. Translator low-side ground pad; same ground net
G05: Ground bus tap (04 / L) → Analog ground bus tap (17 / J); Black. Connect local analog return to main ground
G06: Analog ground bus tap (17 / H) → ADC G (08 / F); Black. ADC supply return and analog reference
G07: ADC G (08 / F) → ADC ADDR (11 / F); Black. Select candidate I2C address 0x48; check for contradictory existing hard strap
G08: Analog ground bus tap (17 / H) → FTP-GND landing pad (18 / F); Black. Sensor ground landing pad
G09: Analog ground bus tap (17 / I) → C1 ground-side lead (15 / J); Black. Short local filter-capacitor return
G10: ESP32 GND (J1.L22) (22 / Q) → Button ground leg (check switched pair) (20 / N); Black. Short button return directly to controller ground; same common-ground net
G11: FTP-GND landing pad (18 / F) → FTP pigtail A / ground (Off-board); Black. Off-board sensor low-reference lead
P01: ESP32 3V3 (J1.L1) (01 / Q) → 3.3 V bus tap (03 / M); Orange. Controller-regulated 3.3 V distribution
P02: 3.3 V bus tap (03 / N) → Display VCC (01 / O); Orange. Display supply at selected 3.3 V
P03: 3.3 V bus tap (03 / O) → Translator LV (10 / M); Orange. Translator low-side voltage reference
P04: ESP32 5Vin (J1.L21) (21 / Q) → Nominal 5 V bus tap (03 / H); Red. USB-derived nominal 5 V distribution; requires IN-OUT closed
P05: Nominal 5 V bus tap (03 / I) → ADC V (07 / F); Red. ADC supply for full sensor voltage range
P06: Nominal 5 V bus tap (03 / J) → Translator HV (10 / I); Red. Translator high-side voltage reference
P07: Nominal 5 V bus tap (03 / H) → FTP-5V landing pad (18 / D); Red. Sensor supply landing pad from the nearer end of the shared 5 V bus
P08: FTP-5V landing pad (18 / D) → FTP pigtail C / 5 V (Off-board); Red. Off-board sensor supply

svg.text: IDs match solder-plan.md • hover SVG wires for details
Black-centered dots = wire endpoints / solder joints.
Crossings and route bends are NOT connections.
Bus strips are explicit links; other pads are isolated.
R1/C1 symbols connect leads through components.
Extra switch legs: support solder only; no added wire.
Bodies are location guides, not measured outlines.
Wire routes are suggestions, not cut-length templates.
Keep 03/L isolated. FTP 5 V uses 18/D, not 18/J.
USB only • IN-OUT closed / USB-OTG open • GPIO19/20 reserved • no firmware or physical tests implied
L04 build aid derived from W01 and the supplied solder-side map. Check the accompanying solder schedule before applying power.
